review_description: We were happy with the way Solar Quotes made getting quotes from reputable suppliers easier

Sales/quote process was thorough with pros & cons assessment of the system.  All questions able to be answered.Installation was clean with very able qualified electrician who explained the system.Evolution Solar arranged everything to connect and once connected returned to explain the system and how to WIFI connect to the inverter.I was extremely impressed and very happy with the result.
Couldn't be happier with Dene and his teamChris did the installation and I would employe him any day. Clean and tidy nothing too much trouble

The most important thing about this supplier was their ability to give me a clear understanding of the solar system that suits my requirements. As a layman, I need to be comfortable with the complete system that is recommended to me. This and my friend's recommendation, helped me to decide on this supplier, although his price was the most expensive when compared with the other quotations.
Very happy with all aspects of our dealings with Evolution Sunshine Coast, we have already recommended them to neighbours and friends and will continue to do so.

Suppliers' names submitted by you all replied to my request for information promptly.I choose Evolution as it was a local supplier and supplied panels and inverter I had decided on as a result of information gained by contact with companies you suggested.
